body.intent: Milestone planning always needs a human: a plan run for a milestone (a record change set, or a request of kind milestone) never runs autonomously, even when the daemon or run is autonomous (rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto); it waits for the owner's interview instead of the arbiter answering. Owner, 2026-11-05: "milestone planning should never be autonomous even in autonomous mode. that always requires a human."
